notes.title: 🐾Demo Update + Festival News! 🐾
notes.notes:
[p]Hello pupventurers![/p][p]We’re excited to share some big news about [i]Donna: The Canine Quest[/i]![/p][p]✨ [b]Demo Update[/b]
The demo has been updated with polish and improvements to make your adventure smoother and even more fun. Whether it’s slaying pesky imps, gearing up with new armor, or exploring Barkhaven, things feel sharper than before. Your feedback has been great, and we’re working hard to keep refining Donna’s journey![/p][p]⚠️ [b]Important Note[/b]
If you played the first version of the demo, we highly recommend [b]starting a new game[/b] to avoid possible bugs or progression issues.[/p][p]🎉 [b]Festival Participation[/b]
We’re thrilled to announce that [i]Donna: The Canine Quest[/i] is part of the [b]No Time to Loot Festival[/b]! This is a fantastic chance for new players to discover Donna’s world.[/p][p]💌 [b]Wishlist & Support[/b]
Every wishlist truly helps us on this journey. If you haven’t yet, please consider adding [i]Donna: The Canine Quest[/i] to your Steam wishlist and sharing it with your friends.[/p][p]Thank you for playing and for joining us on this adventure. Donna still has many quests ahead, and we can’t wait to show you more![/p][p]– Raze Games[/p][p]👉[url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45063983/sale/notimetolootfestival2025"]No Time To Loot Festival[/url][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45176006/5658b60efd37de23d412a3fa95cc73beb1306df0.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: The Demo is Now Available! 🐾
notes.notes:
Hey adventurers!

In this early slice of the game, you'll join Donna, our brave and curious pup, on the beginning of her journey through barkhaven and beyond. Expect exploration, combat, charming characters, and a few surprises along the way.

🐞 Found a bug? Got feedback?
Head over to the [[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2653120/discussions/0/597401407894660030/]Demo Feedback Subforum[/url]] to share your thoughts. We’re listening closely to your comments and will be updating the game based on what we learn during this demo period.

✨ This is just the beginning. Your feedback will help us shape the full game into something truly special.

Thanks for playing, and welcome to Barkhaven!

— Raze Games

notes.title: Official Publisher Announcement!
notes.notes:
[i]For those of you who may not know, working with a game publishing platform like indie.io greatly helps indie developers focus on game development while they handle all the behind-the-scenes magic. From helping manage store pages to crafting marketing campaigns and even helping the game shine at both digital and live events, indie.io helps in all the aspects that indie developers often struggle with alone.[/i]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indieio]indie.io's Steam Publisher Page[/url]

Raze Games is super happy to be working with indie.io as it will allow our small team to focus on what we do best - making our best games!

We’re thrilled to announce that indie.io is the publisher of our games (and we’re honored they chose us too – thank you, indie.io!). There are several reasons why we partnered with them:
[list]
[*] We deeply admire indie.io’s diverse portfolio of indie games, which features a fantastic mix of casual and serious titles spanning genres like fantasy, action, rpg, and more. We believe Donna: The Canine Quest will be a great addition to their lineup and hope to connect with gamers who love these styles!
[*] indie.io gives us the creative freedom to bring our vision to life and create the games we’re passionate about. They don’t dictate what we should make; instead, they support us in making our games the best they can be and ensuring they reach a wider audience.
[*] Here’s a fun fact: indie.io also operates Wiki.GG, an amazing platform for game wikis! We’re excited to partner with Wiki.GG to bring you the Donna: The Canine Quest Wiki. If you enjoy exploring game lore and details, check out Wiki.GG—it might even have a page for your favorite game!
[/list]
[b]Check out Wiki.GG![/b]

Looking ahead, we’re thrilled to partner with indie.io to bring Donna: The Canine Quest to you, the players! This collaboration is an incredible milestone for our small studio, Raze Games. Working with such an amazing publisher will help us grow as developers and deliver authentic, unforgettable gaming experiences.

Don’t forget to wishlist [i]Donna: The Canine Quest[/i]! Follow us on social media to stay updated on future announcements.

Thanks for your support, and a big shoutout to our friends at indie.io for joining us on this exciting journey!

Happy gaming,
Raze Games
